proposal.reason: Main change is in P2P transport IPC registration/deregistration to support multi-segment physical allocations (segment-wise export/import/map, offset-safe reuse, and teardown) in src/transport/p2p.cc. Add memory because allocation/free and registration-lifecycle semantics were updated for multi-segment HG mappings and deregistration callback ordering (src/include/alloc.h, src/register/register.cc). Add network because proxy/IPC FD exchange and proxy-side handle tracking/cleanup behavior changed (src/proxy.cc, src/include/proxy.h, src/include/ipcsocket.h).
